integrity: The projective equivalence and 16-line K4,4 incidence are independently replayed by exact symbolic computation; literature-dependent exhaustion steps are explicitly separated from the computation.
scientific_limitations: Global exhaustion of the 64-line incidence uses the cited complete line enumerations rather than a newly independent 64-line enumeration.
No claim is made about quartic surfaces with fewer than eight inner Galois points.
title: The eight inner Galois points are the eight quadruple points of the Schur line configuration
